terms.definitionEn: A type that permits a value to match one of several alternative member types.
terms.definitionAr: نوع بيسمح للقيمة إنها تطابق واحد من كذا نوع بديل.

terms.definitionEn: A type representing one exact string, numeric, boolean, or other literal value.
terms.definitionAr: نوع بيمثل قيمة literal واحدة محددة زي نص أو رقم أو boolean.

terms.definitionEn: A JavaScript operator whose recognized result can narrow a value's static type in a condition.
terms.definitionAr: operator من JavaScript ونتيجته المعروفة ممكن تضيق النوع داخل شرط.

terms.definitionEn: A property-existence check that can narrow a union to members containing that property.
terms.definitionAr: فحص لوجود property وممكن يضيّق union للأنواع اللي فيها الخاصية دي.

terms.definitionEn: A condition or function pattern that establishes a more specific type for a value.
terms.definitionAr: شرط أو نمط دالة بيثبت نوع أدق للقيمة.

terms.definitionEn: A runtime test that checks an object's prototype chain against a constructor and narrows compatible classes.
terms.definitionAr: فحص وقت التشغيل لسلسلة prototype قدام constructor وممكن يضيّق أنواع classes المتوافقة.

terms.definitionEn: A union of object types sharing a literal-valued property that distinguishes each variant.
terms.definitionAr: union من أنواع objects ليها property literal مشتركة بتميز كل شكل.
terms.example: type Result = { kind: 'ok'; value: string } | { kind: 'error'; message: string };

terms.definitionEn: A shared property whose distinct literal values identify variants in an object union.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية مشتركة وقيمها literal مختلفة بتحدد أشكال الـ union.

terms.definitionEn: Compiler reasoning that tracks checks and assignments to determine a variable's type at each point.
terms.definitionAr: تحليل من الـ compiler بيتابع الشروط والإسنادات عشان يحدد نوع المتغير في كل نقطة.

terms.definitionEn: A function return annotation using a parameter name and type to assert a successful check.
terms.definitionAr: annotation لإرجاع الدالة بتستخدم اسم parameter ونوع عشان تثبت نجاح الفحص.
terms.example: function isText(x: unknown): x is string { return typeof x === 'string'; }

terms.definitionEn: A check that verifies every possible member of a finite union has been handled.
terms.definitionAr: فحص بيتأكد إن كل عضو محتمل في union محدودة اتعالج.

terms.definitionEn: A type used for a value that cannot exist after all union cases have been eliminated.
terms.definitionAr: نوع لقيمة مستحيل تكون موجودة بعد استبعاد كل حالات الـ union.
terms.example: function assertNever(value: never): never { throw new Error('unexpected'); }

questions.code: type Key = string | number;
questions.question: Which value is accepted by Key?
options: An object containing both a string and a number
Only a string containing numeric characters
A string value or a numeric value
A boolean value or an array of numbers
questions.explanation: The union allows a value compatible with either member type.
questions.explanationAr: الـ union بيسمح بقيمة متوافقة مع أي نوع من النوعين.

questions.code: type Direction = 'left' | 'right';
questions.question: Which assignment is compatible with Direction?
options: The string 'up', because all strings are allowed
The exact string literal 'right'
The number 1, as the second listed member
Any value stored in a string variable
questions.explanation: This union contains only the two listed string literal values.
questions.explanationAr: الـ union ده بيقبل قيمتي النص المحددتين بس.

questions.question: What does the typeof check allow inside the branch?
options: It converts every number into uppercase text before the statement runs
It removes string from the parameter's union and keeps only numbers
It narrows value so string methods are available
It changes the function's declared return type based on the checked value
questions.explanation: The recognized typeof check narrows value to string inside that branch.
questions.explanationAr: فحص typeof بيضيّق value لنوع string جوه الفرع.

questions.code:
type Named = { name: string } | { id: number };
function read(x: Named) { if ('name' in x) return x.name; }
questions.question: Why can the branch read x.name?
options: The in operator creates a missing property automatically
Every object union member contains name after assignment
The operator converts id into a string property
The property check narrows x to the member that has name
questions.explanation: The property check narrows the union to shapes that contain name.
questions.explanationAr: فحص الخاصية بيضيّق الـ union للشكل اللي فيه name.

questions.question: What can TypeScript determine in the final return?
options: x is string[] because the string case returned earlier
x is unknown because both branches changed the flow
x is string because length exists on both member types
x becomes any because return statements disable narrowing
questions.explanation: After the string branch returns, the remaining possible type is string[].
questions.explanationAr: بعد ما فرع string بيرجع، النوع المتبقي المحتمل هو string[] بس.

questions.question: What does instanceof establish in this branch?
options: That value is always a plain object with no prototype chain at runtime
That value is an Error instance with its declared members
That value has been converted from unknown into a primitive text value
That every value typed unknown always has a usable message property
questions.explanation: The runtime instance check narrows value to the Error class type.
questions.explanationAr: فحص instance وقت التشغيل بيضيّق value لنوع Error.

questions.question: What does the return annotation communicate to callers?
options: The function always returns the original string
The function converts unknown data into text
A true result means value has the string type
The parameter is optional whenever the test passes
questions.explanation: A type predicate tells the checker which type is established when the function returns true.
questions.explanationAr: الـ type predicate بيقول للـ checker النوع المثبت لما الدالة ترجع true.

questions.code:
type Reply = { kind: 'text'; body: string } | { kind: 'count'; value: number };
function show(r: Reply) { if (r.kind === 'count') return r.value; }
questions.question: How does checking kind help access value?
options: The check changes every property to optional
The number property is inferred from the function name
The test casts the object without checking its contents
The literal discriminant selects the count variant
questions.explanation: A literal-valued discriminant narrows the union to its matching object variant.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة الـ discriminant الـ literal بتختار شكل الـ object المطابق.

questions.code:
type Shape = { kind: 'circle'; radius: number } | { kind: 'square'; side: number };
function area(s: Shape) { switch (s.kind) { case 'circle': return s.radius; case 'square': return s.side; default: const check: never = s; return check; } }
questions.question: Why is assigning s to never useful in the default branch?
options: It causes a type error if a new unhandled variant is added
It converts the remaining variant into a runtime exception
It makes every union member optional in the switch
It disables checking of the discriminant property
questions.explanation: If another variant is added without a case, s is no longer never and the assignment fails.
questions.explanationAr: لو اتضاف شكل جديد من غير case، s مش هتبقى never والإسناد هيفشل.

questions.code:
const value: unknown = 5;
const result = typeof value;
questions.question: What string does JavaScript's typeof operator produce for value?
options: 'number'
'unknown'
'integer'
'object'
questions.explanation: unknown is erased from JavaScript; the runtime value is the number 5.
questions.explanationAr: unknown بيتشال من JavaScript، والقيمة وقت التشغيل رقم 5.

questions.question: What is the runtime value of result?
options: 'open' because the first union member is preferred
'close' because that value was assigned to entry.kind
'AppEvent' because type names are available at runtime
undefined because discriminants are erased
questions.explanation: The assigned object stores the close discriminant as a normal JavaScript string.
questions.explanationAr: الـ object المسند مخزن فيه close كنص عادي في JavaScript.

questions.code: function isNumber(x: unknown): x is number { return typeof x === 'number'; }
questions.question: Which type does the predicate promise when it returns true?
questions.explanation: The predicate's is clause identifies number as the established type.
questions.explanationAr: جزء is في الـ predicate بيحدد إن النوع المثبت هو number.

questions.prompt: Allow either textual or numeric identifiers.
questions.code: type Identifier = string ____ number;
questions.explanation: The vertical bar combines alternative members in a union.
questions.explanationAr: الشرطة العمودية بتجمع الاختيارات في union.

questions.prompt: Check whether input holds textual data.
questions.code: if (____ input === 'string') { input.trim(); }
questions.explanation: typeof is the runtime operator used for this primitive type check.
questions.explanationAr: typeof هو operator وقت التشغيل لفحص النوع البدائي ده.

questions.prompt: Narrow to the object variant that owns a label property.
questions.code: if ('label' ____ item) { item.label; }
questions.explanation: The in operator checks for a property and narrows compatible object unions.
questions.explanationAr: operator in بيفحص وجود property وبيضيق union المتوافق.

questions.prompt: Confirm that the value is an Error instance.
questions.code: if (error ____ Error) { error.message; }
questions.explanation: instanceof checks an object's runtime relationship to a constructor.
questions.explanationAr: instanceof بيفحص علاقة الـ object بالـ constructor وقت التشغيل.

questions.prompt: Declare the predicate that verifies text.
questions.code: function isText(x: unknown): x ____ string { return typeof x === 'string'; }
questions.explanation: The is predicate tells callers which type is established when true.
questions.explanationAr: الـ is predicate بيحدد النوع اللي بيتثبت لما النتيجة true.

questions.prompt: Read the message only from the error variant.
questions.code: if (result.kind === 'error') { result.____; }
questions.explanation: The discriminant check narrows result to the variant that declares message.
questions.explanationAr: فحص الـ discriminant بيضيّق result للشكل اللي معرف message.

questions.prompt: Use the impossible type to check an exhaustive switch default.
questions.code: const unreachable: ____ = value;
questions.explanation: If every union variant was handled, no value remains in the default branch.
questions.explanationAr: لو كل أشكال الـ union اتعالجت، مفيش قيمة بتفضل في الفرع الافتراضي.

questions.prompt: Complete a reusable guard that narrows its argument to a number.
questions.code: function isNumeric(x: unknown): x ____ number { return typeof x === 'number'; }
questions.explanation: A predicate return type uses is followed by the narrowed type.
questions.explanationAr: نوع إرجاع الـ predicate بيستخدم is وبعده النوع المحدد.

questions.question: What is narrowing, and how does TypeScript perform it?
keyPoints: It reduces a union to types compatible with observed checks
Recognized conditions include typeof, in, and instanceof
The result can vary by control-flow branch
questions.modelAnswer: Narrowing uses runtime checks and control-flow context to reduce a value's possible static types. Checks such as typeof, in, instanceof, and comparisons against literal discriminants can establish a more specific type. The type can differ between branches as execution paths separate.
questions.explanation: Narrowing connects runtime evidence with static type checking.
questions.explanationAr: التضييق بيربط أدلة وقت التشغيل بفحص الأنواع الثابت.

questions.question: Why are discriminated unions useful for modeling state?
keyPoints: A literal property identifies each variant
Each variant can carry its own required fields
Branch checks safely expose variant-specific data
questions.modelAnswer: A shared literal-valued property identifies which variant a value represents. Each variant can then require only the fields meaningful for that state. Checking the discriminant narrows the value and makes invalid combinations harder to represent.
questions.explanation: A discriminant gives both readable runtime branching and useful static narrowing.
questions.explanationAr: الـ discriminant بيسهل التفرع وقت التشغيل والتضييق الثابت.

questions.question: What makes a user-defined type guard trustworthy?
keyPoints: Its predicate describes the type established on true
Its runtime implementation must actually verify that claim
A type predicate does not automatically validate data
questions.modelAnswer: A type predicate tells the compiler what type a true result establishes. The function's runtime logic must genuinely check that claim; TypeScript does not prove that the implementation is correct. A dishonest guard can therefore make later code unsafe.
questions.explanation: The predicate is a static promise whose runtime logic remains the author's responsibility.
questions.explanationAr: الـ predicate وعد للـ compiler، والمنطق وقت التشغيل مسؤولية الكاتب.

questions.question: How can exhaustive checking help when a union grows?
keyPoints: Assigning the remaining value to never checks that no case remains
Adding a new member makes an incomplete branch fail type-checking
The check can point maintainers to missing behavior
questions.modelAnswer: After handling every member, the remaining value should have type never. Assigning it to a never variable makes the compiler report an error if a new union member is not handled. This turns a model change into an actionable reminder to update branch behavior.
questions.explanation: Exhaustiveness checks expose omissions during compilation rather than after a new state reaches production.
questions.explanationAr: فحص اكتمال الحالات بيكشف النقص وقت الترجمة بدل ما يظهر بعد وصول حالة جديدة.
